patterns: Chapter numbering: (1) VolumeInfo.chapter_range_start computed globally (7 for vol2 after 6-chapter vol1). (2) LLM may generate local or global numbers depending on prompt. (3) _compute_chapter_offset = sum(max(chapter_numbers)) from earlier volumes. (4) Global = offset + structure_json number. (5) System EXPECTS local but prompt INSTRUCTS global via chapter_number_start. Two parallel implementations in app_service.py and stream_service.py.
dependencies: Backend: SQLAlchemy ORM (Chapter, DetailedOutline, Outline), JSON for structure_json, Jinja2 for prompts. Frontend: chapterStore (useSyncExternalStore), React hooks, SSE. Chain: prompt -> LLM -> parse_service -> structure_json -> _compute_chapter_offset -> _create_chapter_records -> Chapter DB.
integration_points: 1. POST /detailed_outlines/{id}/create_chapters -> create_chapters_from_detailed_outline(). 2. POST /detailed_outlines/{id}/generate_chapters_stream -> _create_chapter_records(). 3. Frontend: useDetailedOutlineState -> chapterStore.invalidateProjectChapters. 4. useChapterMetaList -> chapterStore.subscribeMeta. 5. Outline and writing pages share chapterStore but writing page no auto-refetch on stale.
constraints: 1. Chapter.number unique per outline_id (UniqueConstraint). 2. _compute_chapter_offset uses max() not count(). 3. LLM output non-deterministic re chapter_number_start. 4. Two code paths must produce consistent numbering. 5. structure_json mutable: skeleton overwrites chapters affecting later offsets.
